I recently started playing Hoi again and I was wondering if there are any cool mods out there!
any must have mods for HOI3?
I second this question. And would prefer informed opinions to the Google.

There are three main mods for HoI3 and a lot of smaller flavor mods for different nations.

  • BlackICE: This is probably the biggest and baddest mod of them all (it's around 1 GB). It adds a lot of historical units and models. I think that it really shines when you play Germany with it.
  • HPM: This mods adds a lot of decisions and events that add to the historical plausibility of the game (some think that as railroading). It also merges artillery, AA, and AT into a support unit.

  • TRP: This mod is from the vanilla's original AI coder. It adds a smarter AI (alongside some bug fixes), new province buildings, revamped tech tree, etc.

  • Minor mods: All the stickies here are very good mods. Usually they add some flavour to one specific nation (like The Fox and the Lion or DWI).

There are also a bunch of different mods that add to the game's graphics (like Francesco's counters or some of Chromos' Treasure Chest mods).

A mod I've seen sometimes on r/paradoxplaza is this World War I mod. It adds the startdates for 1910 (before the Italo-Turkish War), and 1914 (New Years' 1914, before the assasination of Franz Ferdinand on June 28).
